messages:
tara-pm: Quick async micro-check on the Q4 OKR milestone — keeping this compact. Please reply with: 1) what shipped since last check, 2) what slipped (if anything) + why, 3) next action and owner. Pinged owners: @alex @sam-eng @maria-p @jin-ml :clock1:

alex: Shipped -> dedupe cache for prefix hits (reduced p99 token work by ~12%), and the telemetry PR for per-route cost tagging landed. Verified in staging. :white_check_mark:

sam-eng: Shipped -> autoscaler policy tweak merged (lower burst threshold). Observed smoother ramp in load tests. Still watching tail latency on long sequences.

maria-p: Product acceptance for the telemetry changes is done, dashboard updated with new per-route breakdowns. No regressions flagged by analytics.

jin-ml: Slipped -> model quantization pipeline for the new 7B variant delayed. Root cause: pinned CUDA driver mismatch on the private pool (dep on eng-infra image update). ETA +5 business days. Owner: jin-ml to coordinate with eng-infra.

alex: Blocker note -> one CR for the cache change still awaiting review (small but risky for cache invalidation). Asking @sam-eng for a quick pair review.

sam-eng: I can take the CR today, will review by EOD. @alex if you can drop the repro steps and a short test plan in the PR it'll speed it up.

alex: Added repro + test plan in the PR. Also left a short snippet for manual validation: `kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-inference --namespace=staging` and check `prometheus:token_latency{route=\"chat\"}` pre/post.

devops-bot: deploy:staging: rollout started for `per-route-telemetry` at 2026-03-16T14:05:12Z (canary 10%).

maria-p: FYI, if quantization slips into next sprint, we should gate any public-facing release that depends on the 7B perf gains. We can still ship routing and telemetry independent of that.

jin-ml: Agreed. Plan B is to ship a fallback model config (unquantized) and enable a canary route to compare cost/latency. I'll draft the fallback config today. Owner: jin-ml.

tara-pm: Thanks — concrete next steps captured: 1) @sam-eng finish CR review (owner: sam-eng, ETA EOD), 2) @jin-ml coordinate eng-infra for driver/image fix (owner: jin-ml, ETA +5bd) and draft fallback config (owner: jin-ml, ETA tomorrow), 3) @alex validate cache rollout in staging after sam review (owner: alex, ETA +1d), 4) prod hold if quantization not ready (product decision once jin updates).

sam-eng: Acknowledge, will ping here when CR done.

alex: Will validate after review and post results in this thread. :mag:

jin-ml: Starting infra sync now, will update here with any blocker details.

tara-pm: Great — if anything slips further, call it out here; otherwise I'll aggregate for the weekly OKR summary. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
